name: Soldering Station, 60 W, 200–480 °C
tagline: 60 W temperature-controlled soldering station, 200 °C to 480 °C with ±2 °C stability, pointed tip supplied.
description: The Vartech 936 A is a 60 W temperature-controlled soldering station for general electronics assembly and repair. Temperature is set between 200 °C and 480 °C with ±2 °C stability, and the 50 W iron heats quickly and recovers fast when it meets a cold joint. The temperature can be calibrated from the front panel, tips change easily, and the tip to ground resistance is below 2 Ω with an ESD-safe design. A pointed tip (I type) is supplied; other tip types are sold separately.

200 °C to 480 °C temperature range with ±2 °C stability
Fast heating and rapid thermal recovery
Temperature calibrated directly from the front panel
ESD-safe design - tip to ground resistance below 2 Ω, potential below 2 mV
Easy tip replacement; pointed (I type) tip supplied
Works with the Vartech tip range, sold separately

name: Digital Soldering Station, 70 W, 3-Channel Memory
tagline: 70 W digital soldering station, 100 °C to 480 °C, with three temperature memories and a password lock.
description: The Vartech 936 AD is a compact digital soldering station with a 70 W metal heating element and an LED temperature display. Temperature is adjustable from 100 °C to 480 °C with ±2 °C stability, and three memory channels store the temperatures you use most. A password stops the settings from being changed, the iron uses high-temperature silicone cable, and the tip to ground resistance is below 2 Ω. A pointed tip is supplied; other tips are sold separately.

name: Digital Soldering Station, Ceramic Heater
tagline: 60 W digital soldering station with a ceramic heater, ±1 °C stability and a key-card lock on the temperature.
description: The Vartech 937 ESD is a 60 W digital soldering station with a 50 W (24 V AC) iron and a ceramic heating element. Temperature is set with soft-touch up and down keys between 200 °C and 480 °C with ±1 °C stability. A key card must be inserted before the temperature can be changed, so the setting stays protected. Tip to ground resistance is below 2 Ω and potential below 2 mV. A pointed tip is supplied, and the 989 SMD hot tweezer is available separately as an attachment.

name: Lead-Free Soldering Station, 90 W
tagline: 90 W lead-free digital soldering station, 80 °C to 480 °C, ceramic heater with PID control.
description: The Vartech 236 ESD is a 90 W digital soldering station for lead-free work, where the higher melting point of the solder needs a fast, powerful heater. Temperature adjusts from 80 °C to 480 °C with ±2 °C stability. The sensor sits inside the ceramic heater and PID control keeps the tip steady, with fast heating and quick recovery under load. ESD-safe design, tip to ground resistance below 2 Ω. A pointed tip is supplied; other tips are sold separately.

name: Lead-Free Soldering Station, 80 W, Electromagnetic Heating
tagline: 80 W lead-free station with electromagnetic heating, a sensor at the tip, PIN lock and auto sleep, 80 °C to 480 °C.
description: The Vartech 202 D is an 80 W lead-free digital soldering station with an electromagnetic heating element driven at 36 V AC, 400 kHz. The temperature sensor sits close to the tip and PID control holds 80 °C to 480 °C with ±2 °C stability. An LCD shows the temperature, a PIN code locks the station parameters, and the station sleeps and shuts off automatically when idle. Output power does not vary with fluctuations in the mains voltage.

name: 2-in-1 Soldering and De-Soldering Station, Lead-Free
tagline: 2-in-1 station: 90 W lead-free soldering plus 90 W vacuum de-soldering for through-hole parts, 200 °C to 480 °C.
description: The Vartech 722 combines a 90 W soldering station and a 90 W vacuum de-soldering gun in one unit, for removing and refitting through-hole (PTH) components. A built-in diaphragm pump (600 mm Hg) pulls molten solder away through the nozzle. Both sections are digitally controlled from 200 °C to 480 °C with closed-loop temperature sensing, the 36 V heater is isolated from the mains, and a password protects the settings. The main unit is designed for lead-free soldering; lead-free de-soldering needs the lead-free de-soldering gun.

ESD-safe; tip to ground resistance 2 Ω or less, potential 2 mV or less

name: De-Soldering Station
tagline: 90 W de-soldering station with a built-in vacuum pump (600 mm Hg), digital temperature control 200 °C to 480 °C.
description: The Vartech 201 B is a 90 W de-soldering station for lifting through-hole components off a board. A built-in diaphragm vacuum pump (600 mm Hg) removes the molten solder, and the heater is digitally controlled from 200 °C to 480 °C with a closed-loop sensor. The 36 V heater is isolated from the mains, the display shows the temperature, and a password protects the settings. ESD-safe, tip to ground resistance 2 Ω or less.
